cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your bin night: Tuesday. Read the whole rota this time; I didn't teach you to stop at whichever box you liked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I took your Thursday. Good memory, half the entry. Read the bit I showed you underneath: 'one week only'.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your request, so I couldn't keep your easy Thursday. You finally made a rule that keeps me honest. It puts you back on Tuesday; bins out, please.

reason: Apply the specific spoken-line repair found during rereading: clarify modifier or sequence placement, replace a strained concluding metaphor, or remove repeated coaching exposition while preserving the requested action.
